comments.value: I personally do not agree with this post they are getting revenue for the player traffic and donations.
Premium servers, and paid benifits would cause some elitism in the community, and would divide the community, so no.

@{5a5b02923ce3fa50a87f9bd8|full_name}: If you think this will cause some elitism then you sir could be among those who would cause the elitism. Obviously if people act elitist that could be in the ruleset or TOS for abusing the membership and they could be dealt with. I would just like a simple way to upload a model and use it, rather than going through third party sites/applications, it only just causes more things you have to do in order to get a model working. It shouldn't be like that. And even after you get the model working, how many tri's does it have? 80,000 ?? 50,000 ?? well you have to decimate the model to the limits in which I find a bit unfair to those with beefy systems, then I go to state the game could be given a model quality option where it physically lowers the quality of all models within the game/server for someone who doesn't have such a beefy system.
Thruthfully, I don't think models cause that much of a performance problem in terms of rendering, maybe if someone has a 18 year old processor and GPU, then that obviously would be hard for anyone to run VRChat. You kind of have to agree with the fact that anyone in their right mind who would play this game with 'VR' in the title would need to have a VR ready GPU and/or CPU to go with it. But thats not all in the case, some PC's that don't have VR ready hardware can still run this game perfectly fine. I don't mean to sound like a jacka$$ but I'm being blunt and honest here. 
I just honestly believe this community would not become a bunch of elitists because of some membership that gives them higher quality models. Sure they might be showoffs and jerks about having the membership but people would just mute them if they are acting that way...

But I guess we can just sit here in 2018 with our crummy models talking to another crummy looking model. 
Or we can grow up and make something great.

@{5a5ad91029ed876b4c73f832|full_name}: Donations yeah, but I mean hard revenue so they can spend more time on the game rather than working a side job and coding the game on the side. Or they could do both even with the hard revenue.

The way i see it, if this had paid benifits and premium servers, it'd be kinda like how Team fortress 2's community is now, where the free to play people will be shunned and put down, and the people who paid would be snobbish and would discourage the people who play for free from ever playing this. 

If you think that i would cause elitism, think twice, before accusing someone of such. 

TL;DR: People will laugh at the poor or the unfortunate.
So its like what america did to net neutrality.

details:
Hi folks at VRChat, and to those who might be reading this particular email.
Me and a few friends thought of an interesting idea for you guys at VRChat to obtain some sort of revenue from your game.
Now hold on there! I don't mean lootboxes or some kind of advertising sellout mode, however you can think of this idea however you would like.

I'm not an expert at stating rules and whatnot, any of the rules stated below are purely from myself, and not from any of my friends, meant as suggestions to be used if the idea is implemented.

So the idea goes;
Memberships, giving access to higher polygon// Tri models meaning the limit is raised from 19,999 to maybe around 100,000 or 70,000 (70,000 being to prevent any hardcore models that are overwhelming to some systems.) Now obviously this system will go through unity as all the other custom models that are uploaded through, and this system can be cracked down on accordingly. As in, if a user is reported for abusing or known for abusing the high polygon// Tri model membership, they could be dealt a ban and/or revocation of the membership. 
So let's say someone got or made a new model and wanted to show it off and there's nothing too fancy about it so and they go through blender and unity to do all the usual that it takes to set it up, and the TRI count reads out 78,000 being it's a relatively high quality model, if they had a membership that allowed them to use 100,000 or less TRI's they could upload it and hop right into VRChat and show it off. 
Then there is the other side, let's say there is someone who made their own model or snagged a copyrighted model from somewhere or made it from scratch using their own textures and whatnot rigging it themselves. So nothing looks too out of the ordinary and the TRI count reads 88,000 and they had the membership, they can also upload it and hop into VRChat and show it off, HOWEVER this person added a few things to it himself, being custom animations and custom moving particles and all sorts of other goodies that could be considered abuse of the high TRI count membership and it begins to lag the server or it begins to crash those within the world who have the model rendered in, that would be a scenario in which a mod could be called into play and take matters into their hands. Then that would mean mods would be required to have a beefy PC to be able to handle exactly whatever this model// player is doing to cause this, and when the mod either see's this model or player they could do what they do best and issue a ban or kick or whatever it is you guys do! Then after they issue a ban or kick, they could review the account connected and see if they have the membership whether it being through steam or through the site directly and either revoke the membership or lower the tri count on the membership.
So technically it would be a live standing membership being you can start with let's say 100k tri count for 20$ or something and if you have good standing with the membership meaning you don't abuse it it stays at 100K and/or raises just a rad bit like 10,000 or something, But if you have a bad standing and are seen or reported abusing this membership your membership could be revoked or if the abuse wasn't as BAD as what some people could do with it, then it could be lowered drastically let's say 50,000 TRI's so that they are forced to use a much lower TRI count model or they would have to decimate that model they were using to be able to use it again. 

As stated above I'm not an expert on giving idea's about rules and guidelines!!!


I have also heard of a third party program being used to bypass the polygon// Tri counter in unity to make it read 19,999 but in reality it is much higher than that, however I do not know what is program specifically is.

I've stated before (just once) in a forum post complaining about the low polygon count limit saying that it's a bit unfair to those who have beefier systems and are wanting to test out high quality models or just wanting to show off. But it is understandable at how you wish to make the game playable for everyone! that is a good thing!
I myself have a beefy system and VRChat runs at your limited frame rate of 91 with the occasional, non-VR stutter on mouse (this is very annoying BTW....) and I'm glad the servers are back up, I was very bored not being able to chat with some random people! Shame that someone would DOS you guys.... tsk.. kana gang? Ugandians ? haha any who, can't point fingers!

Hopefully this email is reviewed and or sent up the chain for review so that this idea can be implemented if agree'd// liked!

I also wanted to point out that the settings menu is a bit lacking in terms of settings, as in game settings. I do know that this isn't a standalone game with it's own engine however I just thought that it might be time to do something with the menu's!
I do love the world selection method, although I think servers should get tags so that people could search for them I.E "Avatar worlds, hang out worlds, open mic worlds, entertainment worlds, theme park worlds, mini game worlds ETC. ETC" I know some people should like this idea!

I also had another idea regarding premium servers, but this can be explained later if this email goes anywhere! don't want to splurge in just 1 email haha!

Anyways, take care, goodnight, good morning, good afternoon, good evening!
Wendy-chan
title: Proposition//Suggestion (Potential revenue for VRChat creators w/ a bonus to players!)
